description: Convert one text into one MP3 with one voice. Use for narration, voiceover scripts, articles, lessons, announcements or any audio whose length can follow the speech. Consumes credits (characters x voice rate). Returns job_id, status and audio_url when ready.

text.description: Text to read. Plain text; long text is split and merged automatically.

wait_seconds.description: Seconds the server waits for the audio before returning. If the job is still PENDING, call get_job_status later with the returned job_id.

name: text_to_speech
title: Text to speech
